blocks.hero.eyebrow: Elizabethtown, KY · Online or in person
blocks.hero.subhead: Freedom Counseling Services already works with clients from Elizabethtown. Meet your counselor online from home, or make the drive to our Louisville office. Many E-town clients do some of each.

facts.text: Choose your counselor, or let us match you

blocks.request.heading: Ready to start, from E-town?
blocks.request.text: Request an appointment in about a minute, or call (502) 523-2970. Most people are seen the same week.

sections.heading: Counseling that fits your week, from E-town
sections.body:
- **Online, from home.** Because Elizabethtown is in Kentucky, you can meet with any Freedom counselor online. No drive, no time off for travel.
- **In person, in Louisville.** Our office is just off Blankenbaker Parkway in Middletown, under an hour from Elizabethtown. Some clients like the drive, and the time to think on the way home.
- **Or both.** Switch from week to week, whenever you need to.

blocks.links.heading: What Elizabethtown clients come to us for

links.items.title: Individual counseling
links.items.text: For anxiety, depression, OCD, or a season of feeling stuck

links.items.title: Couples and marriage counseling
links.items.text: Including pre-marital, in person or online

links.items.title: Christian counseling
links.items.text: For anyone who wants faith at the center

blocks.faith.heading: Faith at the center, never forced
blocks.faith.body: Freedom brings together a biblical worldview, Christian theology, and the best clinical practice. If you'd rather not bring faith into your counseling, you'll get the same excellent care, and your counselor will follow your lead.
blocks.team.heading: Choose your counselor
blocks.team.note: Every counselor is accepting new clients and meets online or in person.

more.heading: What online counseling is like
more.body: Online sessions are the same 50-minute sessions, with the same counselor, by secure video. All you need is a private spot and a phone, tablet, or computer. Most people find it feels like a normal conversation within a few minutes.

blocks.office.heading: If you'd like to come in
blocks.office.directions: Just off Blankenbaker Parkway, across from Southeast Christian Church, in the office complex behind Heine Brothers Coffee. Parking is right outside.
blocks.cost.heading: What it costs
blocks.cost.body: $50 to $165 per session, depending on your counselor, the same online or in person. We don't bill insurance, but we'll give you a superbill to submit for possible out-of-network reimbursement.
